title: xconect tenant payment policy AI artifact workflow
description: Validate the tenant payment policy manifest and generate/read-only-check AI artifacts for internal repo workflows.
commands: npm run xapps -- ai plan --mode internal --from apps/tenants/xconecta/xapps/guards/xconect-tenant-payment-policy/manifest.json --preset internal-v1 --json --out {{ARTIFACTS_DIR}}/xconect-tenant-payment-policy.plan.json

npm run xapps -- ai check --mode internal --plan {{ARTIFACTS_DIR}}/xconect-tenant-payment-policy.plan.json --policy apps/tenants/xconecta/xapps/guards/xconect-tenant-payment-policy/ai/policy.readonly.internal-v1.json --json --out {{ARTIFACTS_DIR}}/xconect-tenant-payment-policy.check.json
